Improvisation: stylistic - 4 bars played twice (8 bars), F/G major, I/V, fanfare or moderato; motivic - 2-bar fragment, response 4-8 bars, F/G major, up to a major 3rd; harmonic - 4-bar sequence x2, I/V, C major.
